name: Touhou Kenchinroku Dai San Wa
original_name: 東方見鎮録 第参話
source:
This time set in that vampire's mansion!
And your targets are... All of them!?

Kantoku who is increasingly growing out of humanity shows off his 
Gungnir to be touched and put it into Private Square and give them shots of white Royal Flare!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE098059.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这次的背景是那个吸血鬼的宅邸！
而你的目标是……全部！？

日益脱离人性的关德展示了他的Gungnir被触摸并将其放入私人广场并给他们射击白色皇家耀斑！
